resources.string: Summaries, reminders and cost control that keep AI affordable.
Understand, distill and process individual articles.
Find what to read, what to subscribe to, and what you\'ve missed.
Batch: daily job; \"Run now\" from the expanded AI features page.
The \"AI health\" block on the subscriptions page lists degrading or dead feeds (tap a row for its controls). Healthy verdicts take no space; all verdicts remain under \"AI results\".

Combines fetch logs and update cadence to diagnose dead, slowing or degrading feeds. Complements the local failure filter: that one asks whether fetching works, this one also catches feeds that fetch fine but are no longer worth reading.
Batch: daily job; \"Run now\" from the expanded AI features page.

The \"Suggested for you\" block on the Add subscription page: matches in the built-in catalog jump straight to filling parameters, name-only ones prefill the catalog search; the full list stays under \"AI results\".
Suggests RSSHub routes or sites worth adding, based on your interest profile and current subscriptions.
Top of the filter rules page: describe it in one line, review each rule, then enable the ones you want.
Proposals are verified right on the filter rules page (the local engine flags examples that do not match); no separate page.
Describe \"what I don\'t want to see\" in plain language; each generated rule is re-checked against real titles by the local engine before you enable it.
The \"Explain\" menu item after long-press text selection in the reader.
A bottom strip: one-line meaning in this article\'s context; not persisted.
Select a term, abbreviation or proper noun in the body and get a one-line, context-aware explanation.
Batch: daily job; the keyword row under the summary card in the reader.
A keyword chip row in the reader; tap to jump into search with that term.
Extracts 5-8 core keywords (proper nouns first), shared with the interest-profile vocabulary.
Batch: daily job; the \"Denoise\" button in the reader.
Its score drives the "Sort by AI value" and "Only worth reading" options in the feed top bar; the reader has a denoise explainer card.
Flags ads, filler, AI-generated bulk content and emotional bait, with a noise suggestion and an information-value score.
The \"Outline\" button at the reader bottom; proactively suggested above a length threshold.
A bottom outline drawer: hierarchical list, tap to scroll to the paragraph.
Breaks a long article into a hierarchical outline with sub-headings you can jump to, plus a one-line gist.
The \"Recommended\" tab in the home feed; the tab can be turned off in settings.
The Recommended tab\'s article stream, with \"show less like this\" feedback and undo.
The recommendation feed\'s backbone: scores by freshness, source affinity and content similarity, then interleaves.
Settings - AI & diagnostics - \"Prompt templates\"; per-feed prompt on the feed action page.
A manager page: built-in template preview + per-feed overrides (edit/clear), variable placeholders supported.
Central management for the global prompt and per-feed summary prompt overrides, with preview and reset.
The \"Ask about this article\" box at the reader bottom, with one-tap follow-ups (explain / impact / timeline).
A bottom Q&A drawer: multi-turn with per-answer \"source paragraph\" citations; not persisted.
Ask questions about the current article; the model answers only from the body and says \"not mentioned in the article\" when unsupported.
The \"Related reading\" strip at the reader bottom; purely local similarity - no model, no quota.
A horizontal card strip at the reader bottom: title + source, tap to open; hidden when empty.
While reading, surfaces related articles across feeds, reusing the recommendation engine\'s content similarity.
Inside the reader top bar\'s share button: \"AI copy\".
A copy picker sheet: three style cards; tap to copy and open the system share sheet.
Generates platform-appropriate share copy for an article (short take / long post / bullet style).
Reading top bar Sparkles button / summary card in the body; per-feed prompt on the feed action page.
A persistent summary card under the title in the reader; refresh never overwrites it.
Generates a conclusion plus 2-4 key points from the article body. Per-feed summary prompts are supported.
A queue page: tasks grouped by status + failure reasons + retry/clear actions.
Queuing, rate limiting, retries and failure traces for all background AI tasks; clear and re-run by hand.
Translation toggle in the reading top bar; re-translate from the bottom action bar.
Replacement-style translation with an in-session LRU cache; not persisted.
Translates the full foreign-language body into Simplified Chinese, preserving HTML structure; switch back to the original anytime.
A usage page: number cards + per-feature call ranking + daily-budget progress bar.
Tracks today\'s / cumulative calls, input-output characters, failure rate and estimated cost.
This only covers queueing, rate limits and failure history for background jobs. To get a feature\'s result right now, expand it in the Features tab and tap "Run now".
Runs as daily batch jobs, limited by concurrency and daily budget.
Runs only when you tap; doesn\'t use background quota.
Uses the saved result if present, otherwise generates once and persists.
Calls the model every time; results are not persisted.
No background features enabled yet — turn some on below before running.
Tasks queued but none executable (today\'s budget may be used up).
Nothing to process (no recent candidates, or artifacts already exist).
All model-calling features are now off
Switched back to the built-in summary prompt
Processed %1$s: %2$s succeeded, %3$s failed (daily budget used up; the rest continue tomorrow)
Processed %1$s: %2$s succeeded (daily budget used up; the rest continue tomorrow)
Run failed — try again later (details in the task queue).
Started in the background — see the queue for progress.
This artifact has no parseable content
No artifacts for this feature yet
Enable some AI features and their results will gather here.
Enabled but nothing yet? Check the task queue on the AI features page.
All AI feature results live here, filterable by feature. Numbers come from the local artifacts table.
Once the cap is hit, no more requests go out today; tasks stay queued for tomorrow.
This will discard %1$s pending tasks in the queue. This cannot be undone.
Turn all model-calling features off (save money)
This will enable %1$s features and may incur API costs.
The recommended feed ranks by your real reading behavior: opened articles, stars and read-later all feed the profile, with more recent actions weighted higher. The profile never leaves your device.
Interest terms appear after you read a few articles; until then the Recommended tab rotates recent unread across your feeds. You can also pick topics above to give it something to start from.
Affinity = this feed\'s historical open rate (recent opens weighted higher), normalized to the strongest feed.
Pick a few topics so recommendations have something to go on before you have a reading history. They weigh less than real reading — articles you actually open will naturally override them.
Showing the top 30 only; the full vocabulary has %1$s terms.
No feed-level prompt overrides yet. All feeds use the built-in template below; tap \"New override\" (top right) to customize a single feed.
Per-feed summary prompt overrides are supported. Available variables: %1$s; leave blank to use the built-in summary prompt.
Save empty to switch back to the built-in template
Available variables: %1$s; leave blank to use the built-in summary prompt.
